purpose: A compact Button with a required accessible label and an optional label tooltip.
behaviorProvider: Shared Button and Base UI Tooltip.

component: Require aria-label and render the shared Button with that accessible name and all remaining Button properties. Children supply the icon.
With tooltip enabled, wrap the button using Base UI Tooltip Trigger render composition and render the same label in a portaled popup. tooltip=false returns only the Button.
host: Supply an action-specific accessible name even when tooltip=false. Hide decorative child icons from assistive technology.
Own operation lifecycle and set loading/disabled while appropriate. Use Tooltip for non-action hints.

requirements.statement: Require aria-label and render the shared Button with that accessible name and all remaining Button properties. Children supply the icon.
With tooltip enabled, wrap the button using Base UI Tooltip Trigger render composition and render the same label in a portaled popup. tooltip=false returns only the Button.
Use token-backed tooltip delay and offset; child Button retains its native activation, disabled and loading behavior.
Supply an action-specific accessible name even when tooltip=false. Hide decorative child icons from assistive technology.
Own operation lifecycle and set loading/disabled while appropriate. Use Tooltip for non-action hints.

Use trigger group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Tooltip is supplementary naming feedback; it is not a replacement for an accessible button name.
The wrapper does not add an async action guard or forward a ref of its own.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
